name: dev-crew
description: A self-evolving delivery crew: it composes a task-fit roster of role subagents (each on its own model tier) and runs them as a gated relay to deliver a target, with editable rosters and a per-repo learning loop. architect → dev → qa → deployer is just one example lineup.

interface.longDescription: A self-evolving delivery crew: it composes a task-fit roster of role subagents (each on its own model tier) and runs them as a gated relay to deliver a target, with editable rosters and a per-repo learning loop. architect → dev → qa → deployer is just one example lineup.
